description: Read the full documentation of one tool before calling it for the first time in a session. Every description in the tool list is deliberately short — what the tool is for and what it costs — and the details that prevent a wrong first call live here: argument semantics, limits, what cannot be undone, and which tool to use instead. Pass the tool name exactly as listed. Cost: no API call, static text, about 1ms. Cheaper than one rejected call.

tool.description: The tool name, exactly as it appears in the tool list
